quarterly_data.signal: 10-Q R&D disaggregation: clinical expenses were $45,682 thousand in Q2 2026 versus $30,052 thousand in Q2 2025 ($81,246 thousand vs $53,012 thousand in H1), while research and engineering expenses fell to $29,730 thousand from $36,637 thousand ($59,213 thousand vs $70,264 thousand in H1); total R&D was $75,460 thousand ($145,507 thousand in H1). Net cash used in operating activities was $154,759 thousand in H1 2026. Eikon relies on contract manufacturing organizations for its product candidates and has no agreements with third-party manufacturers for long-term supply.
